summary.en: The film opens on a real print at full frame; the camera rises and its mount grows round it until it lies on the desk; its chip, then a caption word by word.
summary.zh: 片子从一张满屏的真实截图开场；镜头升起，卡框在它四周长出，直到它躺在桌上；先读它的标签，再逐词落下说明。

fits: The first scene of an exhibit film: the strongest single piece of evidence.
notFor: A logo or title card; an asset that does not survive full frame (below 1920 × 1080 source px).

intent.en: Start inside the evidence, then step back to show it is a print on a desk with a source.
intent.zh: 从证据内里开场，再退后，让人看到它是桌上一张有出处的截图。

content.en: The desk’s prints; this print’s caption (≤ 6 words / 16 字).
content.zh: 桌上的截图；这张的说明（≤ 6 词 / 16 字）。

fits.zh: exhibit 片的第一场：最有力的那一件证据。

notFor.zh: 标志或标题卡；放到满屏会糊的素材（源像素小于 1920 × 1080）。

en: The opening frame is at the zoom cap: crop so it holds at 1.333.
zh: 开场画面在放大上限：裁切要保证 1.333 下仍清楚。

fits: any launch argued from published evidence

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
